children: announced on Tuesday that it continues the rapid expansion of its dual-branded restaurant concept with the opening of a new location in San Antonio, Texas. Less than two years after launching the first standalone U.S. dual-branded restaurant in nearby Seguin, Texas, the iconic Applebee's and IHOP brands are 50 where they sit together in the same building.
The rapid growth of the Dine Brands

concept was said to reflect growing guest demand for greater variety, convenience, and value under one roof. "What began as a bold idea has evolved into a meaningful complement to our development and growth strategies," stated CEO John Peyton. The restaurant company remains on track to open approximately 80 domestic dual-branded restaurants by the end of 2026.

dual-brand concept allows guests to choose from a curated menu featuring both brands, such as IHOP breakfast items alongside Applebee’s burgers, wings, and cocktails while sitting in areas that retain each brand’s look and feel. Behind the scenes, the location shares a kitchen, staff, equipment, and fixed costs. The strategy aims to capture breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night traffic in one footprint, increasing sales potential and improving restaurant-level efficiency.
